reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows RUS successfully measured elastic moduli in a simpler single-phase NbTaTiV HEA, but provides no support for the key premises about advanced signal processing extracting local elastic fields, linking those fields to strength/toughness via scaling laws, Bayesian calibration, or the claimed quantitative gains in efficiency and accuracy for the hierarchical heterostructure.
premises: RUS can accurately measure elastic moduli in refractory HEAs with complex microstructures
Advanced signal processing can extract effective local elastic fields from RUS data
Elasticity scaling laws can link local elastic fields to macroscopic yield strength and fracture toughness
Bayesian calibration with sparse data can refine the mapping from elastic fields to mechanical properties
The method will achieve 3-4 orders of magnitude speedup and 10-20% accuracy improvement over CALPHAD/first-principles
